get_transformed_activations_DKS: get transformed activation functions using the DKS method for a given list of activation names
get_transformed_activations_TAT: get transformed activation functions using the TAT method with leaky relu and smooth activation support
get_transformed_activations_untransforme: get untransformed activation functions by passing method untransformed to skip all DKS or TAT transformations
transform_activation_params: compute optimized activation function parameters to achieve target local C map and Q map slope values
estimate_gaussian_mean: estimate the mean of a function under a standard normal distribution using Gaussian quadrature
